name: Mobile app testing and automation
note: Questions authored by Claude as practice material. Not sourced from your own notes or any official exam. Verify anything you doubt against the docs.

questions.q: Appium drives apps using which protocol style?
questions.why: Appium extends the WebDriver protocol to mobile.

questions.q: Which locator is usually most stable on mobile?
questions.why: Accessibility ids are explicit and cross-platform friendly.

questions.q: Which scenario is specific to mobile testing?
options: Incoming call or notification during use
questions.why: Interruptions, permissions and background/foreground are mobile concerns.

questions.q: Why test on real devices as well as emulators?
options: Real devices expose hardware, performance and OEM differences

questions.q: What are APK and IPA files?
questions.why: APK for Android, IPA for iOS.

questions.q: Which permission check belongs in mobile tests?
options: Allow and deny the permission prompt and confirm the app handles both
questions.why: Users may refuse camera, location or notifications.

questions.q: In Appium, what do capabilities/options define?
options: The platform, device, app and automation driver for the session
questions.why: They tell the server what session to start.

questions.q: Why plan an OS version and device matrix?
options: Behaviour differs across OS versions, screen sizes and manufacturers
questions.why: Pick versions by your user analytics.

questions.q: Which is the most reliable way to automate swipes and gestures on modern Appium?
options: W3C actions with element-relative positions where possible
